title: The workspace query (operations.snapshot) reads the whole Flight Program in one Convex query and passes the 16 MiB read limit at about 2 years 3 months of records; from then on it throws for every role, so nobody can open the program
steps: 1. Local backend, program with 6 aircraft created through the API. 2. Load history with `convex import` at the volume model in profile.json (per aircraft per year: 300 flights, 12 work orders x 15 job cards, 30 discrepancies, 60 flight plans, 30 parts requests, 20 POs; fixed: 300 stock, 600 components, 180 inspections, 240 ADs). 3. Call operations.snapshot as administrator, pilot, owner-group member and board-group member after 1, 2 and 3 years are loaded. One command: bash repro/size/run.sh <checkout> 3
expected: The workspace opens however many years of records the program holds (the query pages or windows what it reads).
actual: Exact, from the local backend's own counters. 1 year (1,800 flights, 1,080 job cards, 72 work orders): 5,977 documents and 9.50 MB read, 7.83 MB returned. 2 years: 9,905 documents, 16.02 MB read (backend warning: 'Many bytes read in a single function execution (actual: 15220707 bytes, limit: 16777216 bytes)'), 13.3 MB returned, 3,359 index ranges read for the administrator. 3 years: every role fails with 'Uncaught Error: Too many bytes read in a single function execution (limit: 16777216 bytes)'. Owners and board members fail too, although they are shown under 1 MB: the query reads everything and narrows afterwards. Growth is about 6.2 MB read per fleet-year = about 3.5 KB per flight flown (with its share of job cards, work orders and the rest), so the limit is reached at roughly 4,000 flights fleet-wide with about 2,400 job cards. The 16 MiB return limit would follow about a month later (13.3 MB returned at 2 years).
evidence: LT/results/server.jsonl (lines name=snapshot and name=usage, steps y01-y03); LT/results/logs-y0*.jsonl (backend execution log); notes/size.md table; convex/operations.ts:100-126 and :318-351 (fullSnapshot), convex/programContext.ts:164-304 (.collect() loaders, no limit)
notes: Job-card size drives it: 3.5 KB per stored job card here (4-5 steps each); cards copied from long inspection templates are bigger and bring the limit closer. Job cards stay in taskCards after close-out (they are archived only when a work-order task is removed), so closed history is read on every load. LT = size test data/.

title: When operations.snapshot throws on the server the app renders a blank page with no message, and it stays blank after a reload: there is no error boundary around the query
steps: 1. Bring the snapshot query to any server error: load 3 years of records (SZ-1), or run it under load at 1-2 years so it passes the 1-second limit (SZ-3). 2. Open the production build, sign in as a pilot. Script: node loadtest/blank.cjs (from the checkout, after repro/size/run.sh; build with `npm run build` and serve with `node scripts/serve-dist.mjs --report-csp --port 4391`).
expected: A message that the workspace could not be loaded, with the cached offline copy still usable and a way to sign out or retry.
actual: After sign-in #root has no children and the body has no text (document.body.innerText === ''). Console: 'Error: [CONVEX Q(operations:snapshot)] ... Too many bytes read in a single function execution'. A reload shows the same blank page, because the session is still signed in and the query fails again; the user cannot reach Sign out, the Sync center or the offline copy. Seen with a first-time sign-in at 3 years (bytes limit), and at 1 and 2 years when the query timed out under machine load.
evidence: shots/size-blank-after-snapshot-failure.png; LT/results/browser.jsonl (y02 and y03 'sign-in to Overview' failures with the console error); src/main.tsx:215-222 (useQuery throws on a failed query), src/main.tsx:479 and src/data/errorReporting.ts:49-56 (createRoot has only Sentry handlers; no ErrorBoundary exists in src/)
notes: The same blank page follows any other snapshot failure, for example the ZodError the query throws when one stored payload no longer parses (documented at convex/operations.ts:98). Not tested: a device that already holds an offline copy; from the code (chooseLiveScreen is never reached because useQuery throws during render) it goes blank too while online.
